escalations.why: risk.Drawdown in docs/packages/risk/contract.md is (ticker, depth, peak_date) but RISK-05 and REP-01 need the trough date too, and tests/fixtures/risk/TC-08/expected.json carries trough_date per ticker; M1-T20 (Drawdown with its dates) cannot meet RISK-05 through the frozen type. Proposed Revise: add 'trough_date: str' to risk.Drawdown (invariant: peak_date <= trough_date; both the first date with no fall) and to the risk.Drawdown and risk.Report samples. M1-T01 is otherwise built to contract.md as written and the gate passes.
